stories.headline: Eric Bauza, voice of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig, dies at 46 - NBC News

stories.headline: Chris Brown given suspended sentence over London nightclub attack - live updates - BBC
stories.summary: The judge says Brown's "repeated use of a glass bottle" against the victim's head was "plainly dangerous". Brown, 37, pleaded guilty in July to a charge of affray.
